floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw_mirrorfix.what: fgw with FGW's own partners kept and each partner on the other side of the pairs' symmetric direction (the smallest eigenvalue's direction of their symmetrised whitened cross-correlation) from its anchor replaced by its mirror image there

fgw_mirrorfix_series.what: fgw_mirrorfix with the second upload's expression (series)
fgw_mirrorfix_series.rule: series: the shallower bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor and then to the deeper bracket's depth (RENDER_RULE, hi). The factor is the T3 script's gene_factor over the cell-type labels that both brackets hold by name with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells each and that are extraembryonic (a name starting with EXE-, or the lineage group ExtraEmbryonicMeso): the ratio of the two brackets' share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions, weights the shallower bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5, rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged, clipped to 0.25-4. It is applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1). The deeper bracket's cells stay as released

fgw_mirrorgate.what: fgw_mirrorfix applied to a stage only where the smallest eigenvalue of its pairs' symmetrised whitened cross-correlation is below 0 (a mirrored direction, row E10); a stage at 0 or above keeps FGW's partners
